title: Payclick
tagline: Building a decentralized employee management and payment system that is user-friendly, secure, and transparent, paving the way for a more efficient and equitable future of work
description:
INSPIRATION 
The platform was inspired by the need to address two critical challenges in the workplace: 
Firstly, the unpredictable cash flow issues faced by employers, particularly those who pay their employees on a weekly or bi-weekly basis. Traditional monthly pay schedules often pose financial management difficulties.
Secondly, there was a need to enhance employee recognition programs, which are frequently seen as ineffective or impersonal, leading to a disconnection and lack of motivation among employees.

WHAT IT DOES
To tackle these challenges, the platform offers:
Salary Scheduling: It enables employers to offer more frequent disbursement of earned wages, providing greater financial flexibility compared to standard pay schedules.
Payroll Payments: The platform integrates seamlessly with existing payroll systems to ensure secure and efficient payroll processing.
NFT-Based Employee Recognition: Unique NFTs are minted monthly for outstanding employees, serving as a valuable and permanent token of appreciation. This innovative approach aims to boost morale and engagement.
how_its_made:
The development of the payclick involved:
Backend Technologies: Utilizing smart contract on Aave protocol to implement GHO, and chainlink automation, the team constructed a robust and scalable backend infrastructure. Blockchain technology was employed for the secure and transparent minting and management of NFTs.
API Integration: The platform was integrated with existing payroll systems for seamless data exchange and automated payment processes. Using tools like Wagmi, Graphql and Rainbowkit.
User Interface: A modern, user-friendly interface was designed for ease of use and accessibility, using Figma for design and hosting the website landing page on Framer.
